# [CS066] Oversized Struct (arch-god-struct)

A struct has too many methods, or many fields combined with behavior.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | LOW |
| **Category** | Architecture |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

A type with more than god_struct_max_methods methods, or more than god_struct_max_fields fields and several methods, usually mixes responsibilities and is hard to change safely. Plain data records with many fields are not reported.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
type Service struct{ /* 25 fields */ }
// ... 30 methods covering billing, email and reporting
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
type Billing struct{ /* ... */ }
type Notifier struct{ /* ... */ }
type Reports struct{ /* ... */ }
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [arch-god-struct]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    arch-god-struct: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore arch-god-struct -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** arch-god-struct
```
